prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering steps, estimated wait countdowns, pet tutorial screens, personality-driven headlines, path duration hints, and account sync safety hints improved performance.
Bypassing onboarding steps yielded mixed results (winning once, but hurting significantly in another test).
Major redesigns, companion benefit story copy, photo guidance copy, and account recovery safety hints significantly hurt performance.
Notifications, layout modifications, incentives, guide screens, permission checks, and most wait info or copy updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions generally overestimated gains across most tests, particularly for redesigns, guide screens, and copy changes.
Predictions underestimated performance for pet control tutorial screens, wait countdowns, personality-driven headlines, path duration hints, and account sync safety hints.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Existing account pet restore hint: Add a clear text hint under sign-in options prompting returning users to sign in with their original account to restore existing pets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again, and account sync safety hints previously proved effective.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-adoption pet naming screen: Add a dedicated pet naming screen right after photo upload to let users name their companion before finalizing adoption. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.3%; introducing personal naming early builds emotional investment before certificate signing.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Companion personality trait selector flow: Insert a trait choice sub-flow screen where users pick companion personality traits (e.g. Playful, Calm) to shape pet behavior. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion in the funnel (69.3%) and users report post-onboarding confusion about controlling and interacting with their pet.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path choice estimated time headline: Update headline on choose path screen to explicitly frame setup time expectations. (why: Path selection mean duration is high (514s); duration hints previously succeeded in setting quick expectations.)
4: [finish, incentive] Desktop pet wake shortcut prompt on finish screen: Add a prominent keyboard shortcut badge and helper hint on the home intro screen detailing desktop pet toggle controls. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion on how to control or hide the pet post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is 71.6%.)
5: [home, notification] Background pet generation ready alert toggle: Enable background notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when pet generation finishes while multitasking. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s because users switch windows during long generation times.)
6: [adoption, layout] Upload photos stage layout update: Update upload photos screen to use stage layout with interactive photo picker and preview components. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong during photo creation.)
